title: Moogie 1 — octave-corrected reconstruction
method: Hardware-only periodicity and harmonic-family analysis from the historical reconstruction, with physical oscillator coarse tuning corrected from -36 to -12 semitones for WIDE off. All inferred played MIDI notes reduced by 24; sounding pitch, event times and velocities unchanged. No preset bytes modified.
uncertainties: Original performance MIDI is unavailable; these notes are an estimate, not a recovered original file.
Played MIDI octave is conditional on the measured WIDE-off range and default system transpose. The original performance MIDI has not been recovered.
Repeated-note onsets and pitch transitions have roughly 20–40 ms uncertainty. Note-offs are assumed to meet the following onset; the hardware audio does not uniquely reveal key release timing.
Velocity is assumed 100 for every note. Both tones have level velocity sensitivity +8; absolute amplitude and any velocity variation remain unverified.
Controller automation, master settings, recording processing and exact demo patch revision are unknown. No controller events were invented.
